name: OAuth refresh-token heartbeat
description: Daily ping of registered Google OAuth files to keep refresh_tokens alive. Google's Testing-mode OAuth apps expire refresh_tokens after 7 days of non-use. This agent calls refresh-token.py once a day to reset the 7-day clock so SEO/GSC/GA4 access stays live even when the seo-opportunity-agent is paused for extended periods. Emails the operator if a refresh fails — early warning before downstream agents break.

metadata.disabled_reason: Disabled 2026-09-04. This agent existed ONLY to reset Google's 7-day refresh-token clock for an OAuth app in Testing publishing status. The consent screen for project 521976426725 is now published 'In production', so refresh tokens no longer expire on that schedule and the daily ping is dead weight. See .claude/skills/refresh-gsc-token/SKILL.md section 6. If refresh tokens start dying weekly again, check the publishing status FIRST -- re-enabling this only hides it.
